name: MOE Standard Guideline for International Students and Language Trainees (rev. 2025-03-14)
summary: Sets the recommended language standards (TOPIK 3 to enter and 4 to graduate at 4-year universities; TOEFL iBT 59 / IELTS 5.5 for English tracks), the funding-proof rules (bank certificate within 30 days, max 6 months), student-name tuition payment and refunds, and bans universities from admitting students for money from agencies.

name: MOE guideline - financial capability table (mirrors MOJ guideline)
summary: Degree programs require KRW 20,000,000/yr (Seoul metro) or KRW 16,000,000/yr (regional); language programs KRW 10,000,000 or 8,000,000 per 6 months (parsed from PDF table; verify, changes often).

name: MOJ/MOE press release: 2025 IEQAS certification and recruitment survey results (2026-02-12)
summary: 181 degree and 123 language programs certified plus 39 'excellent' universities; certified universities get visa screening on the admission letter alone, except for Minister-designated and priority countries; 16 degree and 4 language programs face a visa ban from Fall 2026.

name: MOE - Study Korea 300K Project announcement (2023-08-16)
summary: MOE targets 300,000 international students and a top-10 study-abroad destination ranking by 2027.

name: MOE 'quality turn' international student policy (news of 2026-09-08 release)
summary: Numbers reached 307,464; MOE shifts to quality with a university-agency standard contract, credential verification, stricter certification and AI chatbot support.

name: Asia Today - 300K reached, agency standard agreement, language targets
summary: The standard agency agreement is to be distributed in fall 2026 and later made mandatory by law; the language-standard share rises from 40% (2026) to 60% (2030); recruitment limits for universities in financial crisis from 2029.

name: Financial News - foreign students over 300k, weak universities culled
summary: Tuition refunds and student protections are to be mandated by legal revision; language-standard share targets are 40/45/50/60% for 2026/27/28/30.

name: UNN - 2025 Education Basic Statistics (MOE/KEDI, 1 Apr 2025)
summary: 253,434 international students in 2025 (+21.3%); China 76,541, Vietnam 75,144, Uzbekistan 15,786, Mongolia 15,270, Nepal 12,784.

name: Seoul Economic Daily - 2026 Education Basic Statistics (MOE/KEDI, 26 Aug 2026)
summary: 307,464 international students on 1 Apr 2026; Vietnam 96,834 (31.5%) overtook China 78,890 (25.7%); Uzbekistan 20,876, Nepal 20,118, Mongolia 17,189.

name: Sungshin Women's University - 2026 international student NHIS notice
summary: 2026 student NHIS premium is KRW 79,320/month; D-2 enrolled from entry/registration, D-4 general trainees after 6 months; arrears may affect visa extension.

name: Korean Consulate General New York - 2026 GKS-G notice
summary: 2026 GKS-G covers airfare, full tuition, monthly allowance, insurance and 1 year of language study; applicants must be under 40; deadline 25 Feb 2026.

name: easylaw.go.kr - international student part-time work
summary: Part-time work needs prior permission; D-2-8 and D-4 only after 6 months; weekday hour caps depend on TOPIK level (10/25/30 for undergrad, 15/30/35 for grad); penalties up to 3 years or KRW 30M (table rendering garbled - verify).

name: Jobploy - 2026 D-2/D-4 part-time permit guide
summary: Commercial summary of hour caps citing the HiKorea manual of 9 Jul 2026; D-4 is 10/20/25 h; degree students meeting the language standard have no weekend or vacation cap.

name: Etoday - part-time work deregulation under review (2026)
summary: MOJ is reportedly considering letting students who meet the language standard work without separate permission.

name: Korean Consulate General Los Angeles - D-2/D-4 visa
summary: D-2 requires a standard admission letter; D-4 subtypes are 4-1 (Korean language), 4-2, 4-3 and 4-7; parents' bank statements need family-relationship proof.

name: Korean Embassy in Vietnam - D-2/D-4 visa guidance (updated 2026-06-11)
